claims.text: The McGurk effect is a phenomenon where visual information influences auditory perception, leading to altered perceptions of speech.
An example of the McGurk effect is when the audio of the phoneme 'baa' is paired with a video of someone mouthing 'vaa', leading to perceptions of 'vaa' or 'gaa'.
